about_the_game:
Isles of Isvenness is a cozy creature-collecting idle game with free-floating island biomes that can be moved anywhere on your screen. Play as Kazu the adventurous doggo as you harness elemental aether, collect Aethlings, and complete missions and achievements while focusing on other things.

Collect Aethlings and Harness Elemental Aether

Summon, collect, and deploy your Aethlings across the islands to help gather elemental aether:  Terra, Inferno, and Aqua.  Level up your Aethlings to unlock additional mission abilities and grow your collection with new species and rarity forms.  Participate in dynamic quests that occur at random timepoints to accelerate aether gathering.

Defend the Isles of Isvenness with Aethling Teams

Create teams and protect the Isles of Isvenness from intruders as they attempt to reclaim Aether for their own purposes.  Unique team combinations provide difference enhancements for Kazu to defend against enemy challenges!

Complete Missions to Evolve the Isles of Isvenness

Build Aethling teams based on their abilities and send them on missions.  Succeeding in missions grants you bonus aether and unlocks rare Aethling variants!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10-64 bit
  • Processor: CPU - Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU - NVIDIA Geforce GTX 660
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K | AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 | Radeon RX 5500 XT or Higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

short_description: A cozy creature-collecting idle game featuring vibrantly handcrafted islands that are freely movable on your screen. Harness elemental aether, grow your creature collection, complete missions, and achieve progression milestones at your own pace for a relaxing and rewarding gameplay experience.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
